content:
Hi, I'm Abbas.
My journey hasn't been a straight line. I've worked as a firefighter, completed my military service, and built experience in both sales and insurance advising. Each role taught me something different - discipline, responsibility, communication, and the ability to perform under pressure.
Today, I'm a Computer Science student in Denmark, making a deliberate shift into the world of software development. I'm currently focused on learning Java and object-oriented programming, building a solid technical foundation while working on real projects.
At the same time, I'm a family man. Balancing studies and family life has shaped my mindset - I value structure, consistency, and long-term growth. I'm not just changing careers; I'm building a future.
What drives me is progress. I'm committed to becoming a skilled developer who creates meaningful solutions and continues to grow both professionally and personally.
